name: shortcuts-dialog
title: Shortcuts Dialog
description: A ? dialog that lists the shortcuts available where the person is, grouped by ShortcutScope.
docs: Mount `<ShortcutsDialog />` once. `?` opens it, however the layout types it (`shortcut` changes or, with `null`, removes the key). Touch screens have no `?`, so give it a way in: `<ShortcutsDialog><ShortcutsDialogTrigger>Keyboard shortcuts</ShortcutsDialogTrigger></ShortcutsDialog>` (a `Button` look; it lists the shortcuts of the `ShortcutScope` it sits in), or control it with `open`/`onOpenChange` from a button elsewhere. It reads `listShortcuts()` as it opens, before the modal pauses the page's shortcuts, and lists only shortcuts with a `description`, grouped by scope under each `ShortcutScope label`. `extra` adds rows that aren't registered shortcuts, like a list's own j/k keys. `labels` (`title`, `global`, `open`, `description`) in the page's language; English by default.
